The climate in Turin

Turin is about 240 m above sea level. The warmest month is July, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 970 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in May (about 143 mm).

Best time to visit Turin

The most pleasant weather in Turin is usually in June and September: average highs are between 24°C and 27°C, with up to 12 days of rain a month. In July it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
